about: Inputs from the platform's parity fixture (src/lib/engines/__tests__/fixtures/python-parity.json) plus one year-guard case; expected is the exact output of run(inputs). The platform's parity test checks these outputs against the Python reference engines of the 6 Nov 2026 A/B test (Malta: against an independent Python reference, mt-income-tax.test.ts).

preliminary_tax.due: 31 October 2026, or 18 November 2026 if the 2025 return is filed and the 2025 balance and 2026 preliminary tax are paid through ROS

steps: Taxable income = trading profit EUR 36,500.00 = EUR 36,500.00
Rate band EUR 44,000.00: 20% up to it, 40% above = EUR 7,300.00
Credits: personal EUR 2,000.00 + earned income EUR 2,000.00 = EUR 4,000.00; income tax EUR 3,300.00
USC on EUR 36,500.00 (after capital allowances, before pension) = EUR 641.00
PRSI Class S: EUR 36,500.00 x 4.125% = EUR 1,505.63, at least EUR 650.00 = EUR 1,505.63
Balance for 2025 after preliminary tax paid EUR 0.00 = EUR 5,446.63

Preliminary tax for 2026: 100% of 2025 = EUR 5,446.63; minimum EUR 5,446.63, due 31 October 2026, or 18 November 2026 if the 2025 return is filed and the 2025 balance and 2026 preliminary tax are paid through ROS

constants_used.name: BAND_SINGLE
constants_used.quote: Standard rate band, single or widowed, no qualifying children (s.15, Table Part 1) | first EUR 44,000 at 20%, balance at 40% | 2025 and 2026

constants_used.name: INCOME_TAX_RATES
constants_used.quote: Standard rate band, single or widowed, no qualifying children (s.15, Table Part 1) | first EUR 44,000 at 20%, balance at 40%

constants_used.name: PERSONAL_CREDITS
constants_used.quote: Single Person Tax Credit / Married or Civil Partner Tax Credit (s.461) | EUR 2,000 / EUR 4,000 | 2025 and 2026

constants_used.name: EARNED_INCOME_CREDIT
constants_used.quote: Earned Income Tax Credit (s.472AB) | lower of EUR 2,000 or 20% of qualifying earned income; with the Employee credit, the two together cannot exceed EUR 2,000 | 2025 and 2026

constants_used.name: EARNED_INCOME_CREDIT_SCOPE
constants_used.quote: Then subtract credits; credits reduce tax, not income ... The Earned Income Credit is for self-employed earned income and a proprietary director's pay, not rent or interest.

constants_used.name: USC_PRSI_BEFORE_PENSION
constants_used.quote:
USC: on total income after capital allowances (active traders) but before pension contributions; the surcharge tests non-PAYE income only.
PRSI Class S: on gross income after capital allowances, before pension contributions; minimum EUR 650

constants_used.name: USC_BANDS_2025
constants_used.quote: USC for the 2025 return due now | 0.5% on first EUR 12,012; 2% from EUR 12,012 to EUR 27,382; 3% to EUR 70,044; 8% on the balance | 2025

constants_used.name: USC_EXEMPTION_LIMIT_2026
constants_used.quote: Exemption: no USC if aggregate income does not exceed (s.531AM(2)); above it, USC on the full income | EUR 13,000 | 2026

constants_used.name: USC_MEDICAL_CARD_2026
constants_used.quote:
Reduced rate, full medical card holder under 70, aggregate income EUR 60,000 or less (s.531AN(3)) | Standard bands up to EUR 28,700, then 2% at most on the excess (same result as the reduced rates) | 2026
Above EUR 60,000 the standard rates apply to all income, not just the excess

constants_used.name: USC_NON_PAYE_SURCHARGE_2026
constants_used.quote: Surcharge on relevant (non-PAYE) income over EUR 100,000 (s.531AN(2)) | 3% on the excess, so 11% in total on it | 2026

constants_used.name: CLASS_S_2025
constants_used.quote: PRSI Class S on 2025 income | 4.125% blended, minimum EUR 650 | 2025

constants_used.name: CLASS_S_FLOOR_2026
constants_used.quote: Income floor: below this, no Class S (total before capital allowances) | under EUR 5,000 | 2026

constants_used.name: CLASS_S_FLOOR_TEST
constants_used.quote: a person whose total reckonable income, emoluments and earnings, before capital allowances, is below EUR 5,000

constants_used.name: CLASS_S_RECKONABLE_INCOME
constants_used.quote:
Reckonable income is the aggregate income from all sources for the contribution year, as estimated under the Income Tax Acts, after capital allowances. It leaves out reckonable earnings and reckonable emoluments
so each spouse or civil partner's Class S is worked out on their own income

constants_used.name: PRELIMINARY_TAX_TESTS_2026
constants_used.quote:
Safe harbour 1: current year | 90% of the income tax payable for 2026 | 2026
Safe harbour 2: preceding year | 100% of the income tax payable for 2025 | 2026
Safe harbour 3: pre-preceding year, direct debit payers only | 105% of the income tax payable for 2024; not available if that was nil

constants_used.name: PRELIMINARY_TAX_WORKING_RULE
constants_used.quote: Working rule. For each option: income tax + USC + PRSI for that year, after credits and after tax deducted at source.

constants_used.name: PRELIMINARY_TAX_DUE_2026
constants_used.quote:
Preliminary tax due date (not direct debit) | 31 October of the tax year: 31 October 2026 for 2026 | 2026
ROS extension, 2025 Form 11 balance and 2026 preliminary tax | Wednesday 18 November 2026, only if the person both pays and files through ROS | 2026

constants_used.name: PRELIMINARY_TAX_SHORTFALL_2026
constants_used.quote: The whole 2026 income tax (with USC and PRSI) is treated as due on 31 October 2026 if (a) preliminary tax was not paid, (b) it was less than the lowest test that applies, or (c) it was paid after 31 October 2026 (s.959AO(3)).

assumptions: Irish resident, an active sole trader, aged under 65, insured in Ireland (no A1 certificate for another country)
Only the personal, single person child carer, employee and earned income credits; no other credits or reliefs (rent, medical expenses, Home Carer, HIER)
Jointly assessed if married or in a civil partnership; the spouse's own USC and PRSI on their salary are deducted by their employer and not included
Amounts read to the cent; each charge rounded to the cent, half up

ie-prsi-class-s Example 2: 2025 reckonable income EUR 14,000 -> Class S EUR 650 (minimum)

notes: The 90% test was not used: give next_year_liability_estimate (run this engine for 2026). If the estimate turns out low, that test fails.
If 2026 preliminary tax is not paid by the due date, or is less than the lowest test, the whole 2026 liability is treated as due on 31 October 2026 and interest runs from then.

The skill states the 2025 USC bands but no 2025 exemption limit or non-PAYE surcharge, and the PRSI floor for 2026 only. This 2025 figure is given only because income is above EUR 13,000, non-PAYE income is not above EUR 100,000 and income is at least EUR 5,000, where those rules cannot change it.
